ClawBench V1 Traces
	

Full execution traces for every model run scored in ClawBench V1.
|🏆 Leaderboard | 📊 Benchmark | 📖 Paper | 💻 Code | 🌐 Website |
This is the companion dataset to NAIL-Group/ClawBench. Where the main dataset publishes the task definitions (instructions, rubrics, eval schemas), this one publishes the raw execution data — one directory per (task × model × attempt), each with the screen recording, network capture, browser actions, agent reasoning, and the final… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ZhangArthurHao/ClawBenchV1Trace.
